content.subject: Funding round and reconciliation sprawl
content.draft_text:
Hi Stephanie,
Stord secured $250M funding round, per Bloomberg. That level of capital typically expands intercompany reconciliation sprawl across finance and ops daily.
We build scripts that pull transaction data from source systems into a shared ledger, reconcile entries, and flag mismatches automatically.
Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
Zamp
